files.README.md:
# prisma-ddl-postgresql

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: entities, repositories and services with Prisma 7. It does not create or migrate the database.

## Settings

- Database: postgresql; code: asynchronous (every method returns a Promise).
- Entities: written for the tables the input had no class for.
- Services: take and return DTOs (interfaces).
- Transactions: one transaction per service operation, committed when it ends.
- Lists: lists return pages by offset and limit.

## Layout

```text
prisma/schema.prisma   a model per table, as the database has it; the client is generated from it
prisma.config.ts       where the Prisma CLI finds the schema and DATABASE_URL
src/database.ts        the Prisma client: DATABASE_URL, through the driver adapter
src/errors.ts          NotFoundError, ConflictError, ValidationFailedError: no HTTP codes
src/unit-of-work.ts    the repositories of every table, and the transaction of each operation
src/entities/          one entity per table
src/repositories/      one repository per table
src/services/          one service per table
test/                  repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json     what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
npm install
npm run typecheck && npm run build
TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://app:app@localhost:5432/app npm test   # a real, disposable database: it is emptied
```

Look for `TODO` in the code: each one marks a decision the input did not settle.
files.prisma/schema.prisma:
// Prisma schema of the database, written by DB2CRUD to reflect it: the tables already exist, so do not migrate
// with it. `npm install` generates the client into src/generated/prisma.

generator client {
  provider            = "prisma-client"
  output              = "../src/generated/prisma"
  moduleFormat        = "esm"
  importFileExtension = "js"
}

// The address is in prisma.config.ts (DATABASE_URL); the application connects through src/database.ts
datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  schemas  = ["public", "audit"]
}

enum Mood {
  sad
  ok
  very_happy @map("very happy")

  @@map("mood")
  @@schema("public")
}

model Thing {
  id      String                   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  token   String                   @db.Uuid
  small   Int                      @db.SmallInt
  num     Int?
  big     BigInt
  price   Decimal                  @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  r       Float                    @db.Real
  d       Float?
  flag    Boolean                  @default(true)
  born    DateTime                 @db.Date
  opens   DateTime                 @db.Time(6)
  opensTz DateTime                 @map("opens_tz") @db.Timetz(6)
  at      DateTime                 @db.Timestamp(6)
  atTz    DateTime                 @map("at_tz") @db.Timestamptz(6)
  bin     Bytes
  data    Json
  plain   Json?                    @db.Json
  feeling Mood
  tags    String[]
  /// Prisma has no null lists: numbers is read as an empty one when it is null
  numbers Int[]
  /// TODO: "inet" has no Prisma type here; it is mapped as text
  ip      String?
  /// TODO: the Prisma client cannot read "interval"; the repositories leave span alone
  span    Unsupported("interval")?
  code    String                   @db.Char(5)
  note    String?
  changed DateTime?                @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  /// TODO: total is computed by the database (price * 2); Prisma cannot say so, and the repositories never write it
  total   Decimal?                 @db.Decimal(12, 2)
  order   Order[]                  @relation("Order_thing")

  @@map("things")
  @@schema("public")
}

model Kind {
  code  String   @db.VarChar(10)
  day   DateTime @db.Date
  label String?  @db.VarChar(30)
  order Order[]  @relation("Order_kinds")

  @@id([code, day])
  @@map("kinds")
  @@schema("public")
}

/// CHECK ("group" >= 0): Prisma does not keep CHECK constraints; the services check them
model Order {
  id           BigInt    @id @default(autoincrement()) @map("Id")
  user         String    @db.VarChar(40)
  group        Int       @default(0)
  customerName String    @unique @db.VarChar(60)
  class_       String?   @map("class")
  metadata     String?
  date         DateTime? @db.Date
  time         DateTime? @db.Time(6)
  text         String?   @db.VarChar(20)
  list         String?
  str          String?   @db.VarChar(10)
  int          Int?
  dueDate      DateTime  @db.Date
  closesAt     DateTime? @db.Time(6)
  createdAt    DateTime? @default(now()) @db.Timestamp(6)
  kindCode     String?   @map("kind_code") @db.VarChar(10)
  kindDay      DateTime? @map("kind_day") @db.Date
  thingId      String?   @map("thing_id") @db.Uuid
  parentId     BigInt?
  thing        Thing?    @relation("Order_thing", fields: [thingId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull, onUpdate: NoAction)
  parentIdRef  Order?    @relation("Order_parentIdRef", fields: [parentId], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  kinds        Kind?     @relation("Order_kinds", fields: [kindCode, kindDay], references: [code, day], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  order        Order[]   @relation("Order_parentIdRef")
  entries      Entry[]   @relation("Entry_orderIdRef")

  @@map("Order")
  @@schema("public")
}

model Entry {
  entryNo    Int    @id @default(autoincrement()) @map("entry_no")
  orderId    BigInt
  message    String @db.VarChar(200)
  orderIdRef Order  @relation("Entry_orderIdRef", fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade, onUpdate: NoAction)

  @@map("entries")
  @@schema("audit")
}

model Empty {
  id   BigInt  @id @default(autoincrement())
  note String?

  @@map("empties")
  @@schema("public")
}

/** What services take and return for the "Order" table. */

/** The values of a new Order. Optional fields left out take the database's default. */
export interface OrderCreate {
  user: string
  group?: number
  customerName: string
  class_?: string | null
  metadata?: string | null
  date?: string | null
  time?: string | null
  text?: string | null
  list?: string | null
  str?: string | null
  int?: number | null
  dueDate: string
  closesAt?: string | null
  kindCode?: string | null
  kindDay?: string | null
  thingId?: string | null
  parentId?: number | null
}

/** The values of a Order that change; fields left out keep their value. */
export interface OrderUpdate {
  user?: string
  group?: number
  customerName?: string
  class_?: string | null
  metadata?: string | null
  date?: string | null
  time?: string | null
  text?: string | null
  list?: string | null
  str?: string | null
  int?: number | null
  dueDate?: string
  closesAt?: string | null
  kindCode?: string | null
  kindDay?: string | null
  thingId?: string | null
  parentId?: number | null
}

  id: number

  customerName: string
  class_: string | null
  metadata: string | null

  dueDate: string

}
